function.name: hotel_room_pricing_get
function.description: Get pricing for a specific type of hotel room for specified number of nights. Unlike car_rental_pricing_get, which gets pricing for a rental car, this gets pricing for a hotel room.

hotelName.description: The name of the hotel e.g. Hilton New York

roomType.description: Type of the room to be booked.

nights.description: Number of nights to book the room for.

function.name: car_rental_pricing_get
function.description: Get pricing for a specific type of rental car for a specified number of days. Unlike hotel_room_pricing_get, which gets pricing for a hotel room, this gets pricing for a rental car.

rentalCompany.description: The name of the rental company.

carType.description: Type of the car to be rented.

days.description: Number of days to rent the car.

function.name: flight_ticket_pricing_get
function.description: Get pricing for a specific type of flight ticket for specified number of passengers. Unlike hotel_room_pricing_get, which gets pricing for a hotel room, this gets pricing for a flight ticket.
